title: Surjectivity on first Tor for a quotient after change of rings
statement: Let $R\to A$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings, $I\subseteq R$ an ideal, $J=IA\subseteq A$ the ideal generated by the image of $I$, $M$ an $R$-module, and $N=M\otimes_RA$ its base change to $A$. Choose a free $R$-resolution $F_\bullet\to M$ and a free $A$-resolution $G_\bullet\to N$ with a chain map $F_\bullet\otimes_RA\to G_\bullet$ lifting the identity of $N$. The induced map on first homology $H_1(F_\bullet\otimes_R(A/J))\to H_1(G_\bullet\otimes_A(A/J))$, namely the change-of-rings map $\operatorname{Tor}_1^R(M,A/J)\to\operatorname{Tor}_1^A(N,A/J)$ [def-weil-pbc-tor-modules], is surjective.
